_comment: Evidence -> layer. Evaluated by engine/rules_engine.py with no AI involvement. Highest priority matching rule wins. A rule matches only if every condition in all_of holds and no condition in none_of holds. Facts come from engine/parser.py; the supported vocabulary is listed in that module.

_operators.in: fact is one of value (a list)
_operators.contains: fact is a list containing value, case-insensitive
_operators.matches: fact is text containing value as a case-insensitive substring
_operators.near: fact is numeric and within tolerance of value
_operators.exists: fact is present and not null

rules.title: Large batch cut at a fixed ceiling mid-response
rules.rationale: The connection carried a partial response and was then cut at a round-number elapsed time, on a batch too large to have finished inside that ceiling. A component with a configured response timeout is closing the connection.

elimination_reasons.GalileoDown: Response bytes were received before the cut, and small batches to the same host returned 200 in the same period. A platform that is down does not answer selectively by size.
elimination_reasons.Network: TCP connected and data flowed. A network path failure fails before any response begins.
elimination_reasons.AldavarDB: Records were fetched from the database successfully before the outbound call started.
elimination_reasons.DatabaseViews: The source view returned a non-zero record count.
elimination_reasons.WindowsService: The worker was running and logging throughout the failure.
elimination_reasons.Auth: The request was accepted and began returning data, so the credential was not rejected.

rules.title: Endpoint rejected the credential
rules.rationale: The endpoint answered with an authentication or authorisation status. The request reached the application and was refused at the door.

elimination_reasons.GatewayTimeout: The response was immediate and carried a status code. Nothing timed out.
elimination_reasons.GalileoDown: The endpoint answered. A platform that is down does not return 401.
elimination_reasons.Network: The request reached the endpoint and received a reply.
elimination_reasons.AldavarDB: The database step completed before the outbound call.
elimination_reasons.DatabaseViews: The source view returned a non-zero record count.
elimination_reasons.WindowsService: The worker was running and logging throughout.

rules.title: Platform returned an unavailable status at every batch size
rules.rationale: The endpoint answered with a server-side unavailable status, and it did so regardless of how large the batch was. Size is not the variable.

elimination_reasons.Network: The endpoint answered with an HTTP status, so the path is intact.
elimination_reasons.AldavarDB: The database step completed before the outbound call.
elimination_reasons.DatabaseViews: The source view returned a non-zero record count.
elimination_reasons.WindowsService: The worker was running and logging throughout.
elimination_reasons.Auth: The credential was accepted; the status is a server-side failure, not a rejection.
elimination_reasons.GatewayTimeout: Small batches failed too. A ceiling on response time would let small batches through.

rules.title: Connection never established
rules.rationale: The failure is at connect level. No response bytes were ever received, so nothing downstream of the network path can be implicated.

elimination_reasons.GatewayTimeout: Nothing was cut mid-response because no response ever started.
elimination_reasons.GalileoDown: The platform cannot be assessed. The request never reached it.
elimination_reasons.Auth: No credential was evaluated. The connection failed first.
elimination_reasons.AldavarDB: The database step completed before the outbound call.
elimination_reasons.DatabaseViews: The source view returned a non-zero record count.

rules.title: Database call failed before any records were fetched
rules.rationale: A SQL-level failure occurred at the fetch step. The sync never progressed to its outbound call.

elimination_reasons.GatewayTimeout: No outbound call was made, so nothing could be cut by an intermediary.
elimination_reasons.GalileoDown: Galileo was never contacted on this run.
elimination_reasons.Auth: The endpoint credential was never presented.
elimination_reasons.WindowsService: The worker was running and logging throughout.

rules.title: Worker service stopped or faulted
rules.rationale: The worker itself terminated. Nothing downstream can be assessed from a run that did not complete its own startup path.

elimination_reasons.GatewayTimeout: The worker stopped before completing an outbound call.
elimination_reasons.GalileoDown: Galileo was never contacted on this run.
elimination_reasons.DatabaseViews: The view was never queried to completion.

rules.title: Run completed but fetched zero records
rules.rationale: A clean exit with no rows is a silent failure. The source view is empty or stale, and nothing threw an exception to signal it.

elimination_reasons.GatewayTimeout: No failure occurred. Nothing was cut.
elimination_reasons.AldavarDB: The database answered. It returned an empty result rather than an error.

rules.title: Run completed with records and no errors
rules.rationale: Every batch returned successfully and a non-zero record count was synced.

elimination_reasons.GatewayTimeout: No failure occurred on this run.
elimination_reasons.DatabaseViews: The view returned a non-zero record count.
